operational_gotchas_MUST_READ.mount_sync: File tools (Read/Write/Edit) operate on the REAL Windows files (authoritative). The bash sandbox mount lags and TRUNCATES larger files (often tail loss; sometimes NUL padding; one file stuck stale for the whole session). Read tool = source of truth. Bash-side writes sync back to Windows reliably — use bash writes to repair stale sandbox copies.
operational_gotchas_MUST_READ.bash_quirks: Bash calls intermittently fail with 'process already running' — retry, but verify whether the command actually executed before re-running writes. Each bash call has no cwd/env carryover.
operational_gotchas_MUST_READ.git: Stale .git/*.lock files appear (mount cannot unlink some .git files without permission grant). Fix: mcp__cowork__allow_cowork_file_delete → find .git -name '*.lock' -delete. Commit identity per-command via -c flags.
operational_gotchas_MUST_READ.tailwind_v4: Tokens live in src/index.css @theme (tailwind.config.js is mostly vestigial in v4). Custom duration utilities are NOT generated — use built-in duration-150 etc. --animate-*/--ease-*/--color-*/--radius-*/--shadow-* DO generate utilities.
